							num_mobilized_battalions >= 100
						}
						any_scope_general = {
							NOT = { owner = ROOT }
							owner = { has_technology_researched = wargaming }
						}
						num_front_casualties = {
							target = ROOT
							value >= 50000
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_wargate_wargaming  days = 40 }
		}
		}
	}
}
